scope: Version-pinned asset interpretation and controlled CPU comparisons; not original artist-intent confirmation or runtime GPU acceptance

decision.policy: Preserve original BaseColor alpha; no opaque override for either material. Retain all mesh/material records and unchanged source/converted payload bytes.
decision.future_acceptance: B2/B3 must apply zero opacity to color/depth and shadow, with no occlusion from these faces. glTF BLEND alone does not establish depth/shadow behavior.
decision.mode_equivalence_limit: Current Glass MASK/0.5 and Labels BLEND are retained. Falcor classifies both MASK; zero-opacity/color outcome agrees only for these fixed alpha-zero inputs and does not prove arbitrary-alpha/depth/shadow equivalence.
decision.rationale: Bundled README opacity convention, no exterior scene override, all original DDS mip alpha zero, and version-pinned Falcor texture-alpha source path agree. Opaque diagnostic changes panes to solid dirty surfaces and creates black label faces; label RGB is also zero.
alternatives_rejected: Force alpha=1: conflicts with original opacity and inspected Falcor behavior; does not recover label artwork.
Delete affected geometry/materials: loses source correspondence.
Invent glass transmission/refraction or label artwork: requires an explicit separate asset/display requirement.
decision.invalidation: Re-audit at import/cook when archive, source textures, alpha mode/cutoff, conversion recipe or explicit display overrides change; no per-draw/submit scans or diagnostic payloads.

local_evidence.scope: Pinned source/current-artifact facts only; no artist-intent or Renderer/GPU acceptance claim

unchanged_payloads.meaning: Every shared source/converted/environment/comparison-preview payload matches the current manifest

primary_sources.note: Source review only; no Falcor build/run. Archive CHANGELOG names Falcor 4.0 but not an exact commit. Public 4.0-preview and 4.0.1 tags were reviewed separately, with later 4.4 consistency check; no exact 4.0 tag was returned by GitHub tag refs.

render_report.purpose: Material-only CPU alpha diagnostic, not Renderer/GPU acceptance or proof of artist intent

settings.detail_fill: Optional fixed per-view area light, shared by all three variants; parameters in views

render_report.coverage: IndexMA=1 on the target's opaque copy, zero on all other materials; all scene meshes retained

comparison.interpretation: Controlled finite-sample CPU comparison. Coverage proves the target is in view; opacity changes produce direct and indirect differences. These statistics are not a GPU acceptance threshold or proof of artist intent.

not_executed: Renderer Bistro/native GPU rendering or shadow acceptance
